source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nested conditionals (PDF 43-44).

blocks.text: Kabhi ek condition ke andar doosri condition check karni parti hai. Isay nesting (ek ke andar doosra) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh nested if (if ke andar if) ki shakal (syntax) hai, poora program nahi.
"if condition1:": bahar wali shart.
"    if condition2:": andar wali shart; yeh condition1 ke block mein hai is liye 4 spaces aage hai. Sirf tab check hoti hai jab condition1 True ho.
"        # code ... both ... true": dono shartein True hon to chalne wala code; 8 spaces aage.
"    else:": andar wala else; condition1 True magar condition2 False ho to chalta hai.
"else:": bahar wala else, bahar wale if ke barabar margin par; condition1 False ho to chalta hai.
Indentation hi batati hai kaunsa else kis if ka hai. Comments ki jagah apna asli code likhein, warna IndentationError aata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke syntax mein andar wala if condition2: aur us ka else: bhi bahar wale if ke barabar margin par chhape hain. Nested if mein yeh dono if condition1: ke andar (4 spaces aage) hone chahiyein, jaise oopar diya gaya hai.
Misaal: barish ho aur temperature 15 degree se kam ho to raincoat pehnein. Sirf barish ho to chhatri lein. Barish na ho to din ka maza lein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"weather = "rainy"" aur "temperature = 10": do values jin par faisla hoga.
"if weather == "rainy":": bahar wali shart True hai, is liye andar jaate hain.
"if temperature < 15:": andar wali shart: 10 < 15 True.
"print("Wear a raincoat")": dono shartein True hain, yeh chalta hai.
"else : print("Take an umbrella")": sirf tab jab barish ho magar temperature 15 ya zyada ho.
Bahar wala "else : print("Enjoy your day!")": sirf tab jab weather "rainy" na ho.
Output: Wear a raincoat
Khud try karein: temperature = 20 kar ke Run karein: "Take an umbrella" aayega; weather = "sunny" karein to "Enjoy your day!".
Yahan weather = "rainy" aur temperature = 10 hai: bahar wali condition True, andar wali (10 < 15) bhi True, is liye "Wear a raincoat" print hota hai.

blocks.prompt: weather = "rainy" aur temperature = 20 par program kya print karta hai?
blocks.explanation: "Take an umbrella": barish hai magar andar ki condition temperature < 15 False hai.

items: Nested if: if ke andar if; andar wala block aur aage indented hota hai.
